items.html: For she clarified also all the other aspects at the time of the Ibur; and these too are clarified by her now. Only, at the time of the Ibur they could not be completed and clarified, and in the course of these two years of the Yenika they will be clarified, as mentioned. And also this clarification could not be made until they rose to the place of the breasts, which is a high place in the three middles; and through that ascent they were clarified there and sweetened, and milk was made of what was clarified from them, which is the good that was at first mixed within them.
